Thinking, thinking and thinking#This week we were given the task of starting our semester project, we have to build our first API and doing it solo! Over the summer I built a small chess API for classic chess using SVG and pure java logic, my idea for the semester project is to rebuild and extend chess API into a fully fletched game. Currently my idea is to use a Stockfish which is an open source chess engine and have different game modes. At least for now the idea is to make a training mode and a completely ridicoulus “gameified” version where you can draw powerups and the AI can move for the player either helping or sabotaging.
Link to the current chess API#-Classic Chess
